description: The declared GET /config key surface (DEC-243, extended by DEC-285). Every key the daemon reports, with the mutability it reports it under. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE DECLARATION AND BOTH REPOS READ IT (P8-cb, GUI v2.67.1 / daemon v2.43.8): daemon/tests/ipc_integration.rs::get_config_key_set_and_mutability_are_pinned reads this list and fails if the handler disagrees with it, and tests/test_daemon_config_coverage.py fails if a mutable key has no Settings control. Until P8-cb the Rust test carried its own literal copy of these nine keys and nothing compared the two, so a key added in one and forgotten in the other left that list stale with both suites green -- the sentence above was written before it was true. It is a shared oracle in the parity_vectors.json shape: one byte-identical copy per repo (tests/fixtures here, daemon/tests/fixtures there), compared by test_fixture_copies_are_byte_identical when both repos are checked out as siblings and by .github/workflows/parity.yml in single-repo CI. Adding a daemon config key means updating this fixture (both copies) plus docs/08 section Config management.
